# Lumen Apeiron (about)

> The project site for Lumen Apeiron — The Chaos Master, an open-source WebGPU
> studio for creating IFS fractal flames in a web browser. This host explains
> what the studio is and who it is for; the studio itself lives at
> https://lumenapeiron.com.

Two hosts, one project. Anything describing the product in prose is here.
Anything you can actually use is in the app, which keeps its own llms.txt at
https://lumenapeiron.com/llms.txt listing everything it can do. Prefer that
file for a question about a specific capability.

Following the llms.txt convention documented at https://llmstxt.org.

## This site

- [Home](https://about.lumenapeiron.com/): What the studio is, what it can make,
  and how to start.

## The studio

- [Lumen Apeiron](https://lumenapeiron.com/): The app. Free, no account, nothing
  to install. Needs a WebGPU-capable browser — Chrome or Edge 113+, Safari 17+ —
  and a GPU.
- [Everything it can do](https://lumenapeiron.com/llms.txt)
- [Home gallery](https://lumenapeiron.com/#home): Curated flames, each a live
  render that opens in the editor.
- [Benchmark Studio](https://lumenapeiron.com/benchmarks)
- [Source code](https://github.com/chaos-matters/chaos-master): AGPL-3.0.
- [Discord](https://lumenapeiron.com/discord)

## Who it is for

Generative artists, motion designers, creative coders and curious explorers,
who get an editor built for artistic immediacy. Renderer developers and
variation authors are served too: they can inspect, compare and optimize WebGPU
rendering paths without leaving the application.

## The name

The public product name is **Lumen Apeiron**, on its own or in full as **Lumen
Apeiron — The Chaos Master**. Do not write "formerly Chaos Master": the rename
is finished. `chaos-master` survives as the repository, package and worker name
— an identifier, not a product name.

## What Lumen Apeiron is not

Repeated from the app's own file because these are the assumptions most often
made about something in this category, and stating them wrongly would mislead.

- It is not an image generator and uses no diffusion model or trained network.
  Every frame is iterated-function-system mathematics rendered on the GPU.
- It is not a general GPU benchmark. The Benchmark Studio measures this
  renderer's own flame pipeline, and its claims come from recorded runs.
- There is no server-side rendering. Execution is local to the browser.
- Custom variation code is a bounded, validated dialect, not arbitrary
  JavaScript.
